options.content: AMP application metrics + container capacity; Tempo traces and trace-generated dependency metrics; CloudWatch logs. Panel menu or the panel link opens Explore with the query and time context. Dependency edges require paired client/server spans; no edge series can mean no traffic or a propagation/instrumentation gap. Tool metrics distinguish success, validation errors, dependency errors, and internal errors.

options.content:
**1. Choose a time range** around the incident and select an interesting trace from the error-trace table. **2. Copy its trace ID** into the **Trace / request ID (logs)** textbox at the top and press Enter. The context panel matches `trace_id`, `correlation_id` or `request_id` and includes successful logs for that ID. You can also start with a correlation/request ID from a log.

**Clear the textbox** to return the context panel to failure logs. **Error logs · independent of trace filter** always shows the latest 50 error-like logs in this dashboard’s log groups and time range, regardless of the textbox. Message keyword matching can include false positives.

Use **panel menu → Explore** to adjust the query and retain the selected time range. Explicit panel links open the last 15 minutes. Missing IDs require manual time-window correlation; no matching logs does not prove there were no errors.

panels.title: How to use log and trace correlation

panels.description: Zoom the dashboard time range, then select an interesting trace. Open spans for service-specific timing. At most 20 matching traces; no matches is not a health verdict. For MCP this is caller-side evidence.
panels.title: Failed reservation-tool calls · caller traces

panels.description: Initially shows failure logs. Paste a trace/request ID above to see all matching structured logs, including successful context. Panel menu → Explore preserves the selected time. Missing IDs require manual time-window correlation.

links.title: Explore logs · last 15m · add ID filter

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, @message, trace_id, correlation_id, request_id
| filter ${trace_id:doublequote} = "" or trace_id = ${trace_id:doublequote} or correlation_id = ${trace_id:doublequote} or request_id = ${trace_id:doublequote}
| filter ${trace_id:doublequote} != "" or level like /(?i)(error|fatal|critical)/ or http_status_code >= 500 or http_status >= 500 or event like /(?i)(failed|error|exception)/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 50

panels.title: Failure logs · selected trace / request context

panels.description: Latest 50 error-like logs in the selected time range and dashboard log groups. Ignores the trace/request ID textbox. Matches message keywords, structured HTTP 5xx and failure events; keyword matches can include false positives. Open Explore to refine.
